note: Project facts from the Notion intake pages, keyed by the site's slug (site ids never change). order: 1 = most recent. circa shows in the spec block. glance, standard, role and context give the model grounded detail. Anything under a page's Confidentiality, notes to self, and To fill fields are left out.

intuit.standard: Invoicing has always required a destination. Here it has none. Invoice, payment, and wallet fold into a single conversation inside ChatGPT. Language is reduced to the threshold of understanding. Information appears only where the user arrives. The interface recedes. The transaction remains.
intuit.role: Design and coded prototype. Flow, microcopy, voice. Worked with Intuit leadership.
context: Intuit Wallet and QuickBooks invoicing, inside ChatGPT.
Seven touchpoints: creation prompt, preview and send, confirmation, sign-up, Wallet setup, payment notice, revenue card.
Benefits appear at send, not before. "View in QuickBooks" is the only link-out. The revenue card shows the total and the weekly change, nothing else.
The coded prototype, including voice, won sign-off for a larger effort.

loblaw.glance: The grocer as a front door to care.
loblaw.standard: Health care is a maze. PC Health places a front door inside a loyalty app. Nurses and dietitians on call. Health goals paid in points. A national network, compressed into one device.
loblaw.role: Senior product designer. Design and prototype.
context: PC Health is Loblaw's health and wellness app for iOS and Android, launched October 2020.
Free chat with a care team of registered nurses, dietitians and care navigators. Health goals earn PC Optimum points. A marketplace of health products and services.
2026 scope: new features, an app redesign, and Labs concepts for agentic personal health and commerce.
Scope: app and platform redesign, new features, AI and agentic concepts.

usm-milan.glance: Connected by Our Dreams. USM Haller, softened, in Milan.
usm-milan.standard: A system of steel tubes and chrome balls, unchanged since 1965. Here it receives a soft surface. Connected by Our Dreams stages USM Haller at Spotti, Milan, and debuts the Haller Soft Panel. Rigid frame. Soft skin. Same grammar.
usm-milan.role: Designer on the installation. 3D and rendering.
context: USM's Milan Design Week 2025 installation, designed by Joba Studio.
Spotti Showroom, Viale Piave 27, Porta Venezia. April 7 to 13, 2025.
The debut of the USM Haller Soft Panel.

model-playground.glance: A room to test the models before trusting them.
context: Where Lazarus's models, RikAI and ATLS, are tested. A customer demo tool and an internal tool in one.
An AI agent workflow at Lazarus, built as a customer use case and pitch concept.

lazarus-brand.glance: An identity for AI that has to be trusted. A refresh, extended into a system.
lazarus-brand.standard: Regulated industries refuse the black box. The identity is built as its opposite: legible, exact, accountable. A brand for systems that must show their reasoning.
lazarus-brand.role: Design Director. Owned design across the company.
context: Lazarus AI, founded 2017 in Boston. AI for insurance, healthcare, banking and government. The pitch: explainable AI, every answer traceable.
Scope: a refresh. Color and type system, guidelines, design system, applications.

chatter.glance: Social, rebuilt around groups. Live, not scrolled.
chatter.standard: The feed isolates. Chatter inverts it. Every post belongs to a group, not a timeline. Rooms run live. RocketChats lift one voice above the room. The community, not the individual, is the unit of the network.
chatter.role: Founding designer. App, brand, and system from zero to launch.
context: A group-first social network on iPhone. Live rooms, short video, and RocketChats: paid messages that rise above the room.
Public launch July 2024, announced by Davido.

novart.glance: An art marketplace, in a pocket.
context: Built at Nax Group, a venture studio for products founded in 2018.

fixed-rate-fixed-term.glance: A bond market, on-chain. Fixed rate. Fixed term.
fixed-rate-fixed-term.standard: DeFi lending floats. Fixed Rate fixes it. Rate and term are set in an open order book, not by a pool. Lenders and borrowers meet as makers and takers. Autoroll carries a position past maturity. The mechanism is complex. The surface must not be.
context: Jet Protocol: lending and borrowing on Solana. Launch markets: 1-day and 30-day, in USDC and SOL.
Maker and taker orders. Autoroll renews loans at maturity. Relaunched as Fixed Rate in June 2023.

the-terminal.glance: Professional market data. For everyone else.
the-terminal.standard: Professional market data has always sat behind a paywall and a desk. The Terminal removes both. Data, analysis, and discussion share one surface. A platform funded by the community it serves.
context: Urvin Finance, founded 2021. Funded by about 2,000 community backers on Wefunder.

corelogic.glance: A digital human for real estate.
context: Soul Machines builds Digital People: AI faces animated live by a Digital Brain. CoreLogic: property data and analytics.

nestle.glance: Ruth. A digital human who helps you bake.
nestle.standard: A customer line, given a face. Ruth began as the answer to baking questions phoned in to Nestlé. She now answers them directly: expression, voice, recipe, in real time. The Toll House kitchen, rendered as a person.
nestle.role: Interface and web experience for Ruth.
context: Ruth, the Nestlé Toll House cookie coach, debuted February 2021 on the web.
Built on the USM Haller modular system, with Joba Studio.

lzr-2.glance: One company. Three readers. One argument.
lzr-2.standard: AI for regulated industries is sold against suspicion. LZR 2.0 restates Lazarus for three readers: the practitioner, the buyer, the researcher. Each arrives with a different doubt. Each is answered in turn. Explainability is the organizing idea.
context: Lazarus AI, founded 2017 in Boston. AI for insurance, healthcare, banking and government. Models: RikAI and ATLS, explainable by design.
LZR 2.0 is the phase from August 2025: website and product marketing. Homepage, product pages, research and benchmark pages, for ML practitioners, enterprise buyers and researchers.
Scope: product and platform UI, brand identity, website.
